description: An extra song, in no set, in the folder "Testlied": upper case is not valid in a song ID (STR-10). Its {meta: id} is the valid "testlied", which then differs from the folder name (SNG-12). A second finding cannot be avoided: the song ID is also the file name and the {meta: id} (PF-14), and an {meta: id} equal to the invalid folder name would fail the profile's id syntax (S003) instead.

app.note: SNG-12 is an Error in the app. An app that stops at the first refusing rule reports STR-10.
